data.name: Balgees
data.gender_notes: Balgees is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is devoted to Allah and is humbly obedient to His commands. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'balagh', which means 'to reach', and 'gees' meaning 'servant'. The name Balgees signifies one who has reached the ultimate goal of reaching Allah through righteous actions and devotion. The name Balgees carries the meaning “A servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Balgees usually hope their child will grow to embody a servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes submission and devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Balgees belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A servant of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balgees total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: بالغيس
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الفتاة شديدة الجمال و الروعة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بالغيس هو اسم مؤنث عربي الأصل، ويعني الفتاة التي تتمتع بجمال و روعة لا مثيل لهما، و يوحي بالكمال و الإكتمال في جميع الجوانب، و هو اسم ذو أصول لغوية عميقة و متجذرة في اللغة العربية

in_urdu.name: بالغیس
in_urdu.long_meaning: بالغیس ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت اور جمیلہ، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور روعة کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کا تعلق عربی زبان کی غنی اور ثقافتی روایات سے ہے

in_hindi.name: बलगीस
in_hindi.meaning: बलगीस का अर्थ है सुंदर और आकर्षक
in_hindi.long_meaning: बलगीस एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदर और आकर्षक, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सुंदरता और सৌंदर्य की प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है, और इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा और संस्कृति में हैं

in_pashto.name: بالغیس
